units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 3:6">Ib. 6</cite> <he>פחות מיכן מ׳</he> if a stone fence is less than ten handbreadths high, it comes under the category of a quarry. Y. ib. 34ᶜ bot. <he>מ׳ שבינו וכ׳</he> a quarry situated between two estates.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:22">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>ברוך המ׳ וכ׳</he> blessed the quarry from which it was hewn.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26">Lev. R. s. 26</cite>, end <he>ומלאו המ׳ לפניו וכ׳</he> and they filled the quarry before him with gold Denars.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:7">Esth. R. to I, 6</cite> <he>המ׳ הזה וכ׳</he> this (marble) quarry had not been revealed to any man before &c.
